Feature.Description: Exposes the library file types used by this instrument. The LabOS orchestrator reads this property at discovery time to populate workflow builder dropdowns automatically, without requiring static configuration in lab_config.yaml.

Property.Description: JSON string describing the library file types this instrument uses. Each entry contains: hint (UI identifier), display_name, folder (relative to v1/), file_extension, and parameter_names (SiLA2 parameter identifiers that map to this library type).
